status: DRAFT - AWAITING APPROVAL BEFORE ANY RUN
purpose: Measure headroom for selective looking WITHOUT any learned gaze policy, using a CPU-only small-target benchmark built from ImageNet-100.

arms.name: uniform_downsample
arms.description: Uniform downsample to matched pixel budget

arms.name: random_glimpses
arms.description: Random glimpses at matched pixel budget

arms.name: oracle_glimpses
arms.description: Oracle glimpses using ground-truth target location at matched pixel budget

arms.name: k_glimpses_plus_gist
arms.description: K glimpses of 112 px plus a low-res gist

thresholds_chosen.name: oracle_vs_random_gap_pp
thresholds_chosen.rationale: Proposed threshold requiring substantial headroom above random

thresholds_chosen.name: oracle_vs_uniform_gap_pp
thresholds_chosen.rationale: Proposed threshold requiring substantial headroom above uniform downsample

pass_rule.rule: PASS iff at some budget oracle beats BOTH random and uniform by >= 10 pp on all 3 seeds
conditions: oracle_accuracy(budget) - random_accuracy(budget) >= 10.0 pp for all seeds at the same budget
oracle_accuracy(budget) - uniform_accuracy(budget) >= 10.0 pp for all seeds at the same budget

fail_predeclaration.meaning: If gate0 fails (no budget where oracle beats both random and uniform by >= 10 pp on all 3 seeds), no learned-gaze work is permitted until a new preregistration is written and approved.

notes: All thresholds are flagged as proposed choices. This is a measurement-only gate with no learned policy.
